sn22.14:1.2: rūpaṃ bhikkhave anattā vedanā anattā saññā anattā saṅkhārā anattā viññāṇaṃ anattā.
sn22.14:1.3: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃpi nibbindati vedanāyapi nibbindati saññāyapi nibbindati saṅkhāresupi nibbindati viññāṇasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn22.14:1.4: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn22.14:1.5: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
